title: pycnandra micrantha
intro: Pycnandra micrantha, commonly known as the Tamanu tree, is a plant species native to the Pacific Islands. The health benefits of Pycnandra micrantha include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been used to aid in wound healing and skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-boosting effects, making it useful in treating a variety of health issues. The bioactive constituents of Pycnandra micrantha include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and fatty acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
